an6.46:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahācundo cetīsu viharati sañjātiyaṃ.
an6.46:1.3: tatra kho āyasmā mahācundo bhikkhū āmantesi
an6.46:1.5: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahācundassa paccassosuṃ.
an6.46:2.1: idha āvuso dhammayogā bhikkhū jhāyī bhikkhū apasādenti
an6.46:2.2: ime pana jhāyinomhā jhāyinomhāti jhāyanti pajjhāyanti kiñhime
an6.46:2.3: jhāyanti kintime jhāyanti kathañhi me jhāyantīti
an6.46:2.4: tattha dhammayogā ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti jhāyī ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ
an6.46:3.1: idha panāvuso jhāyī bhikkhū dhammayoge bhikkhū apasādenti
an6.46:3.2: ime pana dhammayogamhā dhammayogamhāti uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākaṭindriyā
an6.46:3.3: kiñhime dhammayogā kintime dhammayogā kathañhime dhammayogāti
an6.46:3.4: tattha jhāyī ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti dhammayogā ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ
an6.46:4.1: idha panāvuso dhammayogā bhikkhū dhammayogānaññeva bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti no jhāyīnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti
an6.46:4.2: tattha dhammayogā ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti jhāyī ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ
an6.46:5.1: idha panāvuso jhāyī bhikkhū jhāñīnaññeva bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti no dhammayogānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti
an6.46:5.2: tattha jhāyī ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti dhammayogā ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ
an6.46:6.2: dhammayogā samānā jhāyīnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsissāmāti
an6.46:6.5: acchariyā hete āvuso puggalā dullabhā lokasmiṃ ye amataṃ dhātuṃ kāyena phusitvā viharanti
an6.46:7.2: jhāyī samānā dhammayogānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vaṇṇaṃ bhāsissāmāti
an6.46:7.5: acchariyā hete āvuso puggalā dullabhā lokasmiṃ ye gambhīraatthapadaṃ paññāya ativijjhapassantīti.
